title: Sub-millivolt voltage imaging reveals gap junction-mediated bioelectric contact inhibition
task: Imaging sub-millivolt membrane potential dynamics in multicellular networks
key_results: Vm variance scales as 1/n with network size; gap junction coupling reduces electrical volatility from ion channels (ANO1, KCa3.1) by >50% in coupled networks
comments: The 1/n scaling is elegant and suggests gap junctions act as electrical capacitors for noise suppression; the bioelectric contact inhibition concept may have implications beyond cancer biology.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gap junction coupling stabilizes membrane potential by suppressing electrical volatility in multicellular networks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: BCI reduces volatility inversely proportional to network size (1/n scaling)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Oncogenic ion channels drive electrical instability that is attenuated by gap junction coupling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ANO1 and KCa3.1 channels show high volatility in isolated cells but reduced volatility in coupled networks

title: YAP delactylation enhances therapy resistance in renal cell carcinoma
task: Reveal lysine lactylation as a regulator of YAP-mediated therapy resistance in renal cell carcinoma

comments: Novel lactylation-based mechanism; YAP-K90T lactylation mimic strengthens functional evidence, but translational potential requires confirmation of HDAC1 inhibitor efficacy in RCC patients.

model_io.model: Renal carcinoma cell lines with targeted therapy resistance
Xenograft tumors in huCD34+HSC NCG mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: HDAC1 is the eraser of YAP-K90 lactylation; HDAC1 inhibition restores lactylation and sensitizes RCC to combination therapy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in cell and xenograft models

title: Levistilide A promotes ferroptosis through the RNF40-HSP90α axis and inhibit colorectal cancer lung metastasis

comments: Clear mechanistic pathway linking E3 ligase-mediated protein degradation to ferroptosis and metastatic control; combination with ferroptosis inducers shows promise but in vivo efficacy requires further validation.
